text: オレの　ゆめが　かなった　のは…

structure.jp: オレの　ゆめが　かなった　のは…
structure.en: the reason my dream came true is...

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the whole action into a thing you can talk about, and は sets it up as the topic. かなった　のは = 'the fact that it came true is...'.
